out_items.name: No bare hand contact with ready-to-eat food, or a pre-approved alternative procedure properly allowed

violations.title: No Bare Hand Contact with RTE Foods
violations.observation: Food employee(s) was observed handling the following ready-to-eat foods using their bare hands: observed employee touch ready to eat tacos with bare hands during inspection.
violations.corrective_action: Except when washing fruits and vegetables, food employees may not contact ready-to-eat foods using their bare hands. Employees shall be using suitable utensils such as deli tissue, spatulas, tongs, or clean disposable gloves to handle all ready-to-eat foods. Proper handling of food and effective handwashing procedures will help prevent foodborne illness. Item discarded. Person in charge corrected employee during inspection. Employee applied gloves during inspection.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: observed raw shell eggs, raw pork above ready to eat foods in walk in cooler.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. Person in charge placed raw animal products below ready to eat foods in walk in cooler.

violations.title: Non-TCS Food Contact Surface, Clean per Manufacturer
violations.observation: Surfaces of ice bins, beverage dispensing nozzles, and enclosed components of equipment are not being cleaned as required. Observed interior surface of ice machine with build up of debris.
violations.corrective_action: Surfaces of utensils and equipment contacting food that is NOT time/temperature control for safety food such as ice bins, beverage dispensing nozzles, and enclosed components of equipment such as ice makers, cooking oil storage tanks and distribution lines, beverage and syrup dispensing lines or tubes, coffee bean grinders, and water vending equipment at a frequency specified by the manufacturer or at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil or mold. Please clean ice machine.

violations.title: Cooling from 135F to 41F, No More than 6 Hours
violations.observation: The following cooked time/temperature control for safety food(s) are not being adequately cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours and to 41F within a total of six hours. Observed chicken wings (43F, >6 hours) in walk in cooler.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety foods shall be cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours and to 41F within a total of six hours to prevent the growth of harmful bacteria. Foods that have been temperature abused are to be discarded. Item discarded. EHS discussed cooling methods with person in charge.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Common Name, Working Containers
violations.observation: Working containers of poisonous and toxic materials are not properly labeled with a common name. Observed unlabeled spray bottles filled with sanitizer at bar.
violations.corrective_action: Label all working containers of poisonous and toxic materials, including cleaners and sanitizers, with a common name to prevent the dangerous misuse of these materials. Please label all working containers used to store chemicals.

out_items.name: Proper cooling methods used; adequate equipment for temperature control

violations.title: Methods to Facilitate Proper Cooling
violations.observation: The following methods used for cooling were not adequate to facilitate proper cooling: observed portioned chicken wings wrapped tightly in plastic bags and stored stacked together in small container, broccolini actively cooling wrapped in plastic wrap.
violations.corrective_action: Cooling hot foods shall be accomplished as follows: 1) placing the food in shallow pans; 2) separating the food into smaller or thinner portions; 3) using rapid cooling equipment; 4) stirring the food in a container placed in an ice water bath; 5) using containers that facilitate heat transfer; 6) adding ice as an ingredient; or other effective methods. Food containers placed in cooling and cold equipment to cool shall be: 1) arranged in the equipment to provide maximum heat transfer through the containers walls, and 2) loosely covered or uncovered as long as protected from contamination to facilitate heat transfer from the surface of the food. EHS discussed cooling methods with person in charge. Person in charge removed plastic wrap from broccolini and discarded chicken wings. Please train staff on proper cooling methods to allow food to properly cool.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Controlling Pests, Pest Control Methods
violations.observation: Methods are not being used to control pests. Observed substantial number of drain flies throughout establishment.
violations.corrective_action: Insects and other pests are capable of transmitting disease to people by contaminating food and food-contact surfaces. If pests are found on the premises methods shall be used to control their presence. Please obtain pest control within 10 days and forward invoice to EHS once service is completed. out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: There is no test kit located in the facility for monitoring the concentration of the chemical sanitizing solutions. Observed no quaternary ammonia test kit on site.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a QUATERNARY AMMONIA test kit. Please order test strips and forward invoice to EHS within 10 days.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed that the wall at the mop sink, ceiling tiles, floor tiles are not maintained in good repair. Observed broken wall corner at mop sink, ceiling tiles with missing vinyl coating above 3 compartment sink near walk in cooler, missing floor tile at floor junction near chip warmer.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. Please repair physical facilities by next routine inspection.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at each handwashing sink. Observed no paper towels at hand sink located at the bar.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. PIC provided paper towels during inspection.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: observed tomatillo sauce (54F) in 3 door prep at cookline; guacamole (45F), half and half (45F), fajita butter (45F) in walk in cooler.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC discarded all items.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: observed walk in cooler at 44F during inspection.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. PIC discarded all TCS foods stored in unit overnight. TCS foods prepared within the last 4 hours moved to alternate, working units to be cooled to 41F or below within proper cooling parameters. PIC contacted technician during inspection and will discontinue use of unit to store TCS foods until repair is made. EHS will conduct a follow up within 10 days once repair is made.
